query: SELECT 'columns' AS section,coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY x.table_name,x.ordinal_position),'[]'::jsonb) AS rows FROM (SELECT table_name,column_name,ordinal_position,data_type,is_nullable,column_default,is_identity FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name IN ('evidence_units','proposition_evidence')) x UNION ALL SELECT 'triggers',coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT c.relname AS table_name,t.tgname,pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid) AS definition FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname IN ('evidence_units','proposition_evidence') AND NOT t.tgisinternal) t
